home.smartAnalyticsDesc: AI-powered insights to help you understand and control your spending habits.
home.automatedTrackingDesc: Securely connect your Gmail to automatically detect transaction emails from banks and merchants. We only read financial emails and never access personal messages.
home.groupExpensesDesc: Split bills with friends and manage group expenses easily, just like Splitwise.
home.whyExpensiaDesc: Expensia is an expense management platform that helps you track spending through secure Gmail integration. We analyze transaction emails from your bank and merchants to provide automated expense categorization, budgeting tools, and financial insights - all while maintaining strict data privacy and security standards.
home.joinToday: Join Expensia today and start your smarter financial journey.
home.heroTitle: Manage Your Finances Effortlessly with Expensia
home.heroSubtitle: Smart expense tracking with Gmail integration. Automatically categorize transactions from your emails while keeping your data secure and private.
home.dataPrivacyDesc: Expensia is built with transparency and security at its core. We clearly explain how we use your data and give you full control over your information.
home.gmailIntegrationDesc: With your permission, we read your emails to automatically detect and categorize transactions. We only access emails containing financial information and never store your email content.
home.dataSecurityDesc: Your financial data is encrypted using industry-standard security measures. We never share your personal information with third parties without your explicit consent.
home.transparentDataUsage: Complete transparency in how we handle your data

common.companyDescription: Modern financial management for everyone. Track expenses, analyze spending, and plan your future.
